All six items are merged into `michael/dev` (`c2a9dfea6`). The Servex changes won't be live until the live Servex is restarted, and I did not restart it.

- ✅ **Fast assistant silent:** it replied to 0 of 8 test sentences, down from 4 of 8. The prompt now tells it to answer only when named, and `Servex/agents/Sessions.js` drops any unaddressed reply. I checked a named sentence ("Fast assistant, …") against the gate directly but did not replay one.
- ⚠️ **Smart cold start:** the first reply fell from 46 s to 6.8 s, so the 6 s target is missed by 0.8 s. Context fell from 68k to 44k tokens, about 35% rather than half. Hiding unused Servex tools saved only 1.3k, so I dropped that.
- ✅ **No task from a statement:** the replay spawned 0 `task-mastermind`s, against 1 in the baseline. The smart assistant now confirms in one line before spawning from a statement.
- ✅ **`page.jsonl` 404:** the open-time 404 on `/framework/page.jsonl` is gone, checked on the worktree server.
- ✅ **Mic line:** the line now says "Mic: idle" right after stop, where before it kept saying "on, level ok".
- ✅ **Sheet height:** the half sheet now defaults to 60% of the screen, and at 400 the thread is 209 px, up from 110 px. The before/after shots are in the task dir but not committed.

The `check_page` run at all four widths was only `layout-check` on `/framework/ux/Dictate/`, reading overflow numbers rather than the pictures. The 404s it reported came from the worktree, which lacks generated `files.jsonl` fi …
